resolutionPolicy.authority: FWA1 resolved installed package version and canonical package role
resolutionPolicy.supported: Exact resolved stable 4.x version; a manifest range is not a resolved version
resolutionPolicy.evidencePin: Every reference to the oracle release must equal referenceRelease.version; do not require an installed user's supported 4.x patch to equal the oracle patch

nextMajor.rule: Announcement alone does not widen this lock. Admit a near-future next major only through explicit ratification with its own exact reference release and cases.
